comment:
* Defines the communication protocol for media route provider services.
 * @hide

variables.name: SERVICE_INTERFACE
variables.comment:
* The {@link Intent} that must be declared as handled by the service.
     * Put this in your manifest.

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_REGISTER
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Register client.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : client version

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_UNREGISTER
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Unregister client.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_CREATE_ROUTE_CONTROLLER
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Create route controller.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : route controller id
     * - CLIENT_DATA_ROUTE_ID : route id string

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_RELEASE_ROUTE_CONTROLLER
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Release route controller.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : route controller id

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_SELECT_ROUTE
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Select route.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : route controller id

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_UNSELECT_ROUTE
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Unselect route.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : route controller id

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_SET_ROUTE_VOLUME
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Set route volume.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : route controller id
     * - CLIENT_DATA_VOLUME : volume integer

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_UPDATE_ROUTE_VOLUME
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Update route volume.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : route controller id
     * - CLIENT_DATA_VOLUME : volume delta integer

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_ROUTE_CONTROL_REQUEST
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Route control request.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : route controller id
     * - obj     : media control intent

variables.name: CLIENT_MSG_SET_DISCOVERY_REQUEST
variables.comment:
(client v1)
     * Sets the discovery request.
     * - replyTo : client messenger
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - obj     : discovery request bundle, or null if none

variables.name: SERVICE_MSG_GENERIC_FAILURE
variables.comment:
(service v1)
     * Generic failure sent in response to any unrecognized or malformed request.
     * - arg1    : request id

variables.name: SERVICE_MSG_GENERIC_SUCCESS
variables.comment:
(service v1)
     * Generic failure sent in response to a successful message.
     * - arg1    : request id

variables.name: SERVICE_MSG_REGISTERED
variables.comment:
(service v1)
     * Registration succeeded.
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - arg2    : server version
     * - obj     : route provider descriptor bundle, or null

variables.name: SERVICE_MSG_CONTROL_REQUEST_SUCCEEDED
variables.comment:
(service v1)
     * Route control request success result.
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - obj     : result data bundle, or null

variables.name: SERVICE_MSG_CONTROL_REQUEST_FAILED
variables.comment:
(service v1)
     * Route control request failure result.
     * - arg1    : request id
     * - obj     : result data bundle, or null
     * - SERVICE_DATA_ERROR: error message

variables.name: SERVICE_MSG_DESCRIPTOR_CHANGED
variables.comment:
(service v1)
     * Route provider descriptor changed.  (unsolicited event)
     * - arg1    : reserved (0)
     * - obj     : route provider descriptor bundle, or null

methods.name: public static boolean isValidRemoteMessenger(Messenger messenger)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the messenger object is valid. *

* The messenger constructor and unparceling code does not check whether the * provided IBinder is a valid IMessenger object. As a result, it's possible * for a peer to send an invalid IBinder that will result in crashes downstream. * This method checks that the messenger is in a valid state. *
